newsitem.title: USA: CME cattle and pork complex pre-opening calls.
newsitem.headline: CME cattle and pork complex pre-opening calls.

text.p: CME cattle and pork complex pre-opening calls as of 0805 CST.
LIVE CATTLE - Steady to up 0.150 cent. Weather market. Boxed beef values down but movement continues active.
FEEDER CATTLE - Off 0.200 to 0.500 cent. Bullish corn crop report will offset support from strong feeder demand.
HOGS - Up 0.200 to 0.100 cent. Weather and pork cutout rise supportive to nearbys, crop report negative to deferreds.
PORK BELLIES - Steady to up 0.200 cent. Lighter hog kills seen on weather reduced hog runs.
